resources.string: Sleek Android home widget music player with circular progress ring.
Ready to detect media playback and update home widgets in real-time.
Notification access is required to detect track info from Spotify, YouTube Music, Apple Music, and others.
How to Add Widgets to Home Screen
1. Touch and hold an empty space on your home screen.\n2. Tap [Widgets] and select [hibiku].\n3. Choose 4x2 Standard, 2x2 Standard, or 2x2 Pure widget and place it on your home screen.
Hide app icon from launcher. Home widgets and notification listener service will continue working normally.\nAccess widget settings by long-pressing any widget.
